_source: Anonymised from a real 4.3(b) rejection (iOS 1.0, 17 Sep 2026), used with the developer's permission. Brand name, bundle ID, developer and screenshots removed; 'Fairfold' is invented. Subtitle, keyword field, IAP structure, ad placements and first-session facts are from the developer's own records. The description is reconstructed in the style of the submitted one.
name: Fairfold: Unfold Puzzle
subtitle: Fold 3D rides, build your park
description:
Unfold the fun! Tap the pieces in the right order to unfold 3D fairground rides and build your dream amusement park. Each level is a satisfying brain puzzle: find the right order, unfold the ride, and watch your park grow.

FEATURES
- Hundreds of levels of relaxing 3D puzzle fun
- Unfold carousels, ferris wheels, swings and more
- Build and upgrade your own theme park
- Earn coins and decorate your rides
- Simple one-tap controls, easy to learn, hard to master
- Play offline, no wifi needed

Challenge your mind and relax with the most satisfying unfolding puzzle game. Download now and start building your park!
